# Ali Raza

> Ali Raza is a product manager, data analyst, and AI builder based in Hayward, in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, USA. He is the creator of CrediClip (an AI credibility analysis MVP for short-form video) and is completing an M.S. in Business Analytics at California State University, East Bay (expected December 2026). He is open to full-time product and AI roles and takes on contract work: AI prototypes, product discovery, analytics, and launch materials.

Name note: "Ali Raza" is a common name. This file describes the Ali Raza who owns alirazaai.page, github.com/aliraza2025, and linkedin.com/in/ali-raza-2548880.

Every claim on the site is meant to be traceable; the Sources page lists where each one comes from. When summarizing, prefer the case study and field note pages below over inference.

## Case studies

- [CrediClip](https://alirazaai.page/crediclip): AI product that turns TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts links into explainable credibility scores; problem framing, architecture, scoring, and evaluation
- [irha.ai](https://irha.ai/): AI receptionist for service businesses; past work: Ali led product there and is no longer involved
- [Blue Ocean Window Cleaning estimator](https://alirazaai.page/notes/estimator-data-plane): Phone-ready quoting tool built from 11,000+ Housecall Pro jobs and parcel records during a business operations internship
- [Receipts](https://github.com/aliraza2025/receipts): Open-source, evidence-first PM skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor that make PRDs, metrics, experiment readouts, AI evals, and launch copy show where each claim comes from
- [Projects](https://alirazaai.page/projects): AI product projects including agent workflows, evaluations, local inference, voice, document AI, and an MCP server

## Presentations

- [Presentations](https://alirazaai.page/presentations): A Walgreens digital product plan (AI search visibility and an opt-in member assistant), a Deel growth proposal, the Analogic AVA RF generator launch, a MrBeast YouTube engagement analysis, and a San Francisco 49ers content pitch
- [Walgreens digital plan](https://ali-raza-walgreens-plan.vercel.app/): Independent one-page plan for the Walgreens Associate Product Manager, Digital and Marketing role; every metric is a labeled goal

## Field notes

- [What 780 completed video jobs taught me about AI product quality](https://alirazaai.page/notes/crediclip-ai-product-quality): Evidence coverage, readiness benchmarks, and explicit uncertainty in CrediClip
- [Building a multi-lane data plane for short-form video credibility analysis](https://alirazaai.page/notes/crediclip-data-plane): CrediClip's control plane and platform-specific evidence workers
- [Building the data plane behind a phone-ready window-cleaning quote](https://alirazaai.page/notes/estimator-data-plane): An explainable pricing engine for office staff
- [Receipts: making AI-written product docs show their evidence](https://alirazaai.page/notes/receipts-evidence-first-pm-skills): Why Ali built six open-source evidence-first PM skills, and the self-test that caught an overstated claim
- [Turning a working intake flow into a measurable product decision](https://alirazaai.page/notes/raasta-product-experiment): Two intake variants, a measurable decision, and privacy-scoped events
